verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com that gives LLMs structured access to AWS service documentation, including SES. They also confirm that SES developer-guide pages are served as Markdown (.html.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly SES docs. missing for 10: an SES-specific llms.txt (the file found is AWS-wide), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
